en: Black-and-white landscape view of a coastal rural settlement with scattered wooden houses, open rocky fields, and sparse trees near a body of water. In the foreground is a simple wooden house with a gabled tile roof, surrounded by vegetation and flagpoles. More small houses and dirt roads extend into the background. In the lower left corner is a caption with the place name, and in the lower right is a small triangular publisher logo with a number.
